name: ShapeGrid-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Longest run of filled violet cells trails the cursor across the grid.

tagline: A violet grid scrolls diagonally and lights up under the cursor.
summary: A canvas of thin violet squares covers the stage and slides on a diagonal. Moving the pointer fills the hovered cell and leaves a short trailing line of lit cells behind it.
appearance: A near-black stage is covered edge to edge with a grid of thin violet squares, evenly spaced. A few cells fill solid violet, and a dark vignette fades the corners away.
behaviour: The grid drifts on a diagonal and wraps round without a seam. Wherever the pointer goes, the cell under it lights up and a short trail of filled cells fades out behind.
demo_content: A 44px square grid in violet on near-black with a six-cell hover trail.
search_phrases: purple grid background with cursor trail
grid that lights up on hover
moving line grid for a hero
hover trail on a square grid
use_when: A dark tech or product section wants a moving grid that answers the pointer.
avoid_when: Hundreds of thin lines can look busy behind small copy and cost frames on weak phones.
customise: Direction, speed, cell size, border and hover colours, shape and trail length are props; the vignette colour is hardcoded.
weight_why: Redraws roughly 300 stroked cells on a 2D canvas every frame.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with no labels; the scroll and hover trail ignore reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Clean, even grid and a readable hover trail; the lines are faint and only one shape is shown.
